property_summary: After calling SetLogFile with an arbitrary address and then Collect with zero amount when acc.balance is zero but MinSum is also zero, the reference contract releases the nonReentrant lock so Initialized() succeeds, while the buggy contract keeps the lock locked so Initialized() reverts.
change_summary: Remove the locked_ = false; line from the end of the nonReentrant_ modifier, so that the lock is never released after execution.
